title: How Big Is the GTA 6 Map? Leonida vs GTA 5 and Red Dead 2
desc: GTA 6's map is reportedly about twice the size of GTA 5's, and Vice City alone is said to be twice Los Santos. Here's what Rockstar has said and what's only estimated.
lede: Short answer: about twice the size of GTA 5, according to what Rockstar has told interviewers. Exact square-mile numbers are fan estimates, so treat those with care.
sections: Rockstar has described Leonida as roughly double GTA 5's map. Rockstar North's Rob Nelson reportedly said Vice City on its own is about twice the size of Los Santos, and Rockstar has said you won't see everything just by playing the story missions.
One report says Rockstar described the map as about three times RDR2's playable area. That figure depends on how you count water and empty land.

Some estimates count land only, others include the sea around the Keys. That's why you'll see anything from about 1.7x to 2.5x GTA 5 online. Until people map it after launch, "about twice GTA 5" is the safest answer.
Vice City, the Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga. Our guide to all six.
faq: How big is the GTA 6 map?
About twice the size of GTA 5's, according to Rockstar's interviews. Exact areas are still estimates.
Is GTA 6 bigger than Red Dead Redemption 2?
Yes. One report says Rockstar described it as about three times RDR2's playable area.
